Maya R.: Proposal: run a 10-day credit sprint — 40 free credits + a short benchmark post + a 25-min demo webinar. Condition: must run 1 curated prompt template to unlock. Primary goal = 7-day active rate.
Tom H.: sounds good. split test whether credits are redeemable immediately vs after first successful run?
Maya R.: yes A/B that. Target cohorts: NA + EU. Keep APAC later.
Lina C.: I'll draft three copy angles: benchmark-led, quick-play tutorial, and product demo teaser. CTAs: 'Claim 40 credits' / 'Try prompt pack' / 'Save a seat'.
Vik P.: Ops: form -> Segment -> cohort: credit_sprint_v1. utm_campaign=credit_sprint. Credits expire 12 days. Add captcha.
Tom H.: measurement: funnel imps -> form -> credit_claimed -> first_success -> day7_active -> demo_request. Track token spend and first-success latency.
Maya R.: timeline: go-live 2026-06-08, webinar 2026-06-14, analysis cut 2026-06-22. Creatives due 2026-06-02.
ops-bot: :white_check_mark: Webinar created (ID: 4277). RSVP: https://events.redwood.ai/r/4277. Reminders: 24h & 1h.
Lina C.: posting cadence: day 0 launch, day 3 benchmark snippet, day 6 webinar reminder. I'll share drafts in the doc.
Vik P.: routing rule snippet added to ticket. Also will ensure promo codes are single-use and tied to user ID.
Maya R.: legal confirmed promo. Quick sync tomorrow 9am to finalize mapping and tracking keys.
Tom H.: noted. Sam (analytics) please add cohort to weekly dashboard.
